rules.rationale: Performance improvement programme for sepsis screening is recommended for hospitals and health systems.
rules.citation: For hospitals and health [SNOMED: 263775005] systems, we recommend using a performance improvement programme [SNOMED: 720311000000105] for sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008], including sepsis screening [SNOMED: 870441004] for acutely ill, high-risk patients...

rules.rationale: qSOFA is recommended against compared to SIRS, NEWS, or MEWS as a single screening tool for sepsis.
rules.citation: * [MODERATE] We recommend against using qSOFA compared to SIRS, NEWS [SNOMED: 1287358002], or MEWS as a single screening [SNOMED: 722021000000100] tool [SNOMED: 86967005] for sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008] or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007].

rules.rationale: Measuring blood lactate is suggested for adults suspected of having sepsis.
rules.citation: * [VERY LOW [SNOMED: 260362008]] For adults suspected of having sepsis [SNOMED: 91302008], we suggest measuring blood [SNOMED: 119273009] lactate [SNOMED: 83036002].
